https://www.nasa.gov/centers-and-facilit.s: NASA is helping Virginia to secure its energy future by sharing its meteorological data. This partnership will aid state officials in planning for extreme weather and energy demands, improving energy security and reliability.

https://theconversation.com/php-is-in-th.s: PHP is a programming language that powers most websites, with estimates suggesting around 70% of websites run on it. The recent vulnerability in PHP's core system and libraries allows attackers to run unauthorized commands on hosting computers, giving them access to data and full control of websites.

https://www.sciencealert.com/16-years-af.s: After 16 years, deep sea life in the Gulf of Mexico has not recovered from the 2010 oil spill disaster. Scientists found that fish, crustaceans, and squid populations have sharply declined, impacting the ecosystem's health and economic viability.

https://phys.org/news/2026-10-antibiotic.s: Researchers from a Hungarian research center propose a framework to predict antibiotic resistance early in drug development. This could help identify and refine promising drug candidates, preventing costly failures. Identifying genetic changes that allow bacteria to resist drugs could also inform the redesign of the molecule itself, making it harder for resistance to evolve.

https://phys.org/news/2026-10-stellar-co.s: Some young stars in the Orion Nebula are surrounded by disks of gas and dust. These disks should have disappeared long ago due to radiation from the central star, but they do not. Researchers propose that two stars in a binary system merged, causing one to be knocked out of orbit and eventually collide. This scenario could explain why the disks appear younger than the stars.

https://phys.org/news/2026-10-scientists.s: Mitochondria, the powerhouses of cells, have a unique structure with two membranes separated by a space. A new study reveals a protein called SPRIZ that controls this space, allowing cells to adjust the internal architecture of their powerhouses. This discovery could help explain how mitochondrial dysfunction contributes to diseases like Parkinson's.

https://www.therobotreport.com/generativ.s: Generative Bionics plans to launch a Physical AI Data Factory in Italy, aiming to generate data for humanoid robots in Europe, thus advancing sovereignty in robotics. This hub will help move robotics from labs to industrial use, providing high-fidelity data and training models for European industry.
